findings.issue: Terminal stream branch returned success without checking already-buffered incomplete trailing event.
findings.resolution: Finish() runs after Feed and before delivering the terminal chunk; undelivered event metadata is included in Finish. Legitimate terminal streams still finish without waiting for transport EOF.

findings.issue: Messages typed deltas allowed malformed text values or a payload for the wrong content block.
findings.resolution: Known delta types check the corresponding block kind and required non-null string field; unknown extension handling remains unchanged.

findings.issue: OAuth import compensation could restore token bytes while losing the prior disabled runtime state or permit cancellation to commit.
findings.resolution: Bounded cleanup independent of cancellation restores file and original status then confirms status. Post-upload/discovery cancellation checks prevent candidate commit. Six cancellation/commit and prior-state combinations passed under race detector.

findings.issue: HTTP 200 followed by protocol/source parsing exception retained row.ok=true and could pass release acceptance.
findings.resolution: Exception paths now explicitly fail the row and preserve diagnostic failure reports. Independent in-memory reproduction with HTTP200/not-json previously returned overall ok=true; final regression rejects this shape and requires nonzero CLI exit.

findings.issue: Release SSE checker accepted EOF-undispatched terminal frames and ignored Chat [DONE] in other protocols.
findings.resolution: Reject trailing data/event fields without a blank-line dispatch and limit [DONE] to Chat. Three-protocol fixtures cover truncated terminal/tail, valid comment trailer and extra protocol marker.

limits: This review establishes scoped source and local-fixture behavior, not external provider or real client acceptance.
The gateway intentionally closes after a validated terminal chunk; it checks all bytes already returned by that Read and does not wait for hypothetical later transport frames.
Full repository, real age, Docker, chroot, systemd and deployment checks are owned by the primary agent and were not repeated independently here.
OAuth adapter restore failures remain explicit incomplete-compensation results requiring state inspection; real revoked provider grants still require reauthorization.
